<svg width="800" height="400" viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>Simplified World Map</title>

  <defs>
    <style>
      .continent {
        stroke: #000;
        stroke-width: 0.5;
      }
      .label {
        font-size: 10px;
        font-family: sans-serif;
        fill: black;
        text-anchor: middle;
        dominant-baseline: middle; /* Important for vertical centering */
        pointer-events: none; /* Make text unclickable */
      }

      /* Continent Colors */
      #north-america { fill: #90EE90; } /* Light Green */
      #south-america { fill: #228B22; } /* Forest Green */
      #europe { fill: #FFFFE0; }        /* Light Yellow */
      #asia { fill: #F0E68C; }        /* Khaki */
      #africa { fill: #FFA07A; }      /* Light Salmon */
      #oceania { fill: #ADD8E6; }    /* Light Blue */
      #antarctica { fill: #FFFFFF; }   /* White */
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background (Ocean) -->
  <rect width="800" height="400" fill="#ADD8E6" />


  <!-- Continents (Simplified Shapes) -->
  <g id="north-america" class="continent">
    <path d="M 100,100 L 150,50 L 250,80 L 280,150 L 200,200 L 150,180 Z" />

  </g>
  <g id="oceania" class="continent">

  <!-- Ocean Background -->
  <rect width="1000" height="600" fill="#A8D5E5"/>
  
  <!-- Subtle ocean wave pattern -->
  <defs>
    <pattern id="waves" x="0" y="0" width="100" height="50" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M 0,25 Q 25,15 50,25 T 100,25" stroke="#9AC9DA" fill="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1000" height="600" fill="url(#waves)"/>
  
  <!-- North America -->
  <path d="M 120,80 L 280,80 L 320,140 L 300,200 L 280,260 L 250,300 L 220,320 L 200,340 L 180,330 L 150,280 L 130,220 L 110,160 L 100,120 Z" 
        fill="#E8B57F" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Central America / Mexico connector -->
  <path d="M 200,340 L 230,360 L 250,380 L 240,400 L 220,390 Z" 
        fill="#E8B57F" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- South America -->
  <path d="M 250,400 L 300,395 L 330,420 L 340,470 L 330,520 L 310,560 L 290,580 L 270,575 L 250,540 L 240,490 L 235,450 Z" 
        fill="#7FBF7F" stroke="#3B6B3B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Europe -->
  <path d="M 460,90 L 540,85 L 580,100 L 600,130 L 580,160 L 550,170 L 510,175 L 470,170 L 450,150 L 445,120 Z" 
        fill="#BF7FBF" stroke="#5B2B5B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Africa -->
  <path d="M 470,200 L 560,195 L 600,220 L 620,280 L 615,350 L 590,420 L 560,470 L 530,490 L 500,485 L 480,460 L 460,410 L 450,350 L 455,280 L 460,230 Z" 
        fill="#D4A04C" stroke="#7A5C20" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Asia -->
  <path d="M 600,80 L 750,75 L 850,90 L 900,130 L 920,180 L 900,220 L 870,250 L 820,270 L 780,275 L 740,270 L 700,250 L 660,220 L 630,180 L 610,130 Z" 
        fill="#E55B5B" stroke="#8B2B2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- India peninsula (part of Asia) -->
  <path d="M 700,250 L 720,260 L 730,290 L 725,320 L 710,330 L 700,310 L 695,280 Z" 
        fill="#E55B5B" stroke="#8B2B2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Southeast Asia (islands) -->
  <circle cx="800" cy="310" r="12" fill="#E55B5B" stroke="#8B2B2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="820" cy="330" r="8" fill="#E55B5B" stroke="#8B2B2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="845" cy="320" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#E55B5B" stroke="#8B2B2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Australia -->
  <path d="M 800,420 L 880,415 L 920,440 L 925,480 L 900,510 L 850,520 L 810,510 L 790,480 L 785,450 Z" 
        fill="#B59F6B" stroke="#6B5A2B" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Antarctica (bottom strip) -->
  <path d="M 50,560 L 950,555 L 970,580 L 950,595 L 50,595 L 30,575 Z" 
        fill="#E0E8F0" stroke="#8B9BA8" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="500" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A3A5C">
    Simplified World Map
  </text>
  
  <!-- Country Labels with leaders/dots -->
  <!-- USA -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="180" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="215" y="184" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    United States
  </text>
  <text x="215" y="200" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#444">
    (Washington, D.C.)
  </text>
  
  <!-- Brazil -->
  <circle cx="290" cy="470" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="305" y="474" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    Brazil
  </text>
  <text x="305" y="490" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#444">
    (Brasília)
  </text>
  
  <!-- Russia -->
  <circle cx="750" cy="130" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="765" y="134" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    Russia
  </text>
  <text x="765" y="150" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#444">
    (Moscow)
  </text>
  
  <!-- China -->
  <circle cx="800" cy="200" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="815" y="204" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    China
  </text>
  <text x="815" y="220" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#444">
    (Beijing)
  </text>
  
  <!-- India -->
  <circle cx="712" cy="290" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="725" y="294" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    India
  </text>
  <text x="725" y="310" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#444">
    (New Delhi)
  </text>
  
  <!-- Australia -->
  <circle cx="855" cy="470" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="780" y="464" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    Australia
  </text>
  <text x="780" y="480" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#444">
    (Canberra)
  </text>
  
  <!-- Egypt (bonus) -->
  <circle cx="555" cy="240" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="565" y="244" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    Egypt
  </text>
  
  <!-- France (bonus) -->
  <circle cx="490" cy="135" r="4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
  <text x="500" y="139" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    France
  </text>
  
  <!-- Legend -->
  <rect x="20" y="500" width="200" height="85" fill="white" stroke="#1A1A1A" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.9" rx="5"/>
  <text x="30" y="520" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">
    Continents
  </text>
  
  <rect x="30" y="528" width="14" height="10" fill="#E8B57F" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="50" y="537" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">North America</text>
  
  <rect x="30" y="542" width="14" height="10" fill="#7FBF7F" stroke="#3B6B3B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="50" y="551" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">South America</text>
  
  <rect x="30" y="556" width="14" height="10" fill="#BF7FBF" stroke="#5B2B5B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="50" y="565" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">Europe</text>
  
  <rect x="30" y="570" width="14" height="10" fill="#D4A04C" stroke="#7A5C20" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="50" y="579" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">Africa</text>
  
  <rect x="120" y="528" width="14" height="10" fill="#E55B5B" stroke="#8B2B2B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="140" y="537" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">Asia</text>
  
  <rect x="120" y="542" width="14" height="10" fill="#B59F6B" stroke="#6B5A2B" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="140" y="551" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">Australia</text>
  
  <rect x="120" y="556" width="14" height="10" fill="#E0E8F0" stroke="#8B9BA8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="140" y="565" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#1A1A1A">Antarctica</text>
  
  <!-- Compass Rose -->
  <g transform="translate(940, 80)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="30" fill="white" stroke="#1A1A1A" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.8"/>
    <path d="M 0,-25 L 5,0 L 0,5 L -5,0 Z" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <path d="M 0,25 L 5,0 L 0,-5 L -5,0 Z" fill="#888888"/>
    <path d="M -25,0 L 0,5 L 5,0 L 0,-5 Z" fill="#888888"/>
    <path d="M 25,0 L 0,5 L -5,0 L 0,-5 Z" fill="#888888"/>
    <text x="0" y="-32" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A1A">N</text>
  </g>
</svg>

prompt: Create a simplified world map as an SVG showing major continents with different colors. Add labels for at least 5 major countries.
content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 500" width="100%" height="100%" role="img" aria-label="Simplified world map showing major continents in different colors with labels for 6 major countries">
  <defs>
    <!-- Style for readable text on colored backgrounds -->
    <style>
      .country-label {
        font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        fill: #263238;
        text-anchor: middle;
        stroke: #ffffff;
        stroke-width: 3px;
        paint-order: stroke fill;
      }
      .continent {
        stroke: #ffffff;
        stroke-width: 2px;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      }
      .continent:hover {
        opacity: 0.85;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .title {
        font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
        font-size: 28px;
        font-weight: 800;
        fill: #37474F;
        text-anchor: middle;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
      }
      .ocean {
        fill: #E3F2FD;
      }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ocean Background -->
  <rect class="ocean" width="1000" height="500" />

  <!-- Map Title -->
  <text class="title" x="500" y="45">Simplified World Map</text>

  <!-- Continents Group -->
  <g id="continents">
    <!-- North America -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#E57373" d="M 110,90 L 270,60 L 330,110 L 310,170 L 270,190 L 250,240 L 190,230 L 140,180 L 100,130 Z" />
    <!-- Greenland -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#E57373" d="M 330,50 L 380,40 L 390,80 L 340,90 Z" />
    
    <!-- South America -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#81C784" d="M 260,250 L 320,240 L 350,290 L 330,370 L 290,430 L 260,370 L 250,290 Z" />
    
    <!-- Europe -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#64B5F6" d="M 450,80 L 530,70 L 560,110 L 540,150 L 490,160 L 450,130 Z" />
    
    <!-- Africa -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#FFB74D" d="M 460,170 L 530,160 L 590,180 L 610,260 L 580,350 L 520,400 L 470,320 L 450,230 Z" />
    <!-- Madagascar -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#FFB74D" d="M 600,330 L 620,320 L 625,360 L 605,370 Z" />
    
    <!-- Asia -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#BA68C8" d="M 550,80 L 720,60 L 860,100 L 880,160 L 810,230 L 730,250 L 650,220 L 580,170 L 550,120 Z" />
    
    <!-- Australia / Oceania -->
    <path class="continent" fill="#4DB6AC" d="M 760,320 L 860,310 L 890,360 L 850,410 L 780,400 L 750,350 Z" />
  </g>

  <!-- Country Labels Group -->
  <g id="labels">
    <!-- 1. United States -->
    <text class="country-label" x="210" y="160">United States</text>
    
    <!-- 2. Brazil -->
    <text class="country-label" x="295" y="330">Brazil</text>
    
    <!-- 3. Russia -->
    <text class="country-label" x="680" y="110">Russia</text>
    
    <!-- 4. China -->
    <text class="country-label" x="740" y="170">China</text>
    
    <!-- 5. South Africa -->
    <text class="country-label" x="520" y="370">South Africa</text>
    
    <!-- 6. Australia -->
    <text class="country-label" x="815" y="365">Australia</text>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 800 450" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Definitions -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Ocean gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="oceanGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1e3a5f"/>
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#2c5282"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#2b6cb0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Continent gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="naGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#48bb78"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#38a169"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="saGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#ed8936"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#dd6b20"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="euGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4299e1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#3182ce"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="afGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#ecc94b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#d69e2e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="asGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#f56565"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#e53e3e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="auGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#9f7aea"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#805ad5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="anGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#e2e8f0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#cbd5e0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Glow filter for labels -->
    <filter id="textGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Drop shadow -->
    <filter id="dropShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="1" dy="1" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.3"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Ocean background -->
  <rect width="800" height="450" fill="url(#oceanGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Subtle graticule lines -->
  <g stroke="#2c5282" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.3">
    <!-- Longitude lines -->
    <line x1="80" y1="0" x2="80" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="160" y1="0" x2="160" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="240" y1="0" x2="240" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="0" x2="400" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="480" y1="0" x2="480" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="560" y1="0" x2="560" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="450"/>
    <line x1="720" y1="0" x2="720" y2="450"/>
    <!-- Latitude lines -->
    <line x1="0" y1="50" x2="800" y2="50"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="125" x2="800" y2="125"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="200" x2="800" y2="200"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="275" x2="800" y2="275"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="350" x2="800" y2="350"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="400" x2="800" y2="400"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Equator line -->
  <line x1="0" y1="225" x2="800" y2="225" stroke="#ecc94b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8,4" opacity="0.6"/>
  <text x="780" y="220" fill="#ecc94b" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="end" opacity="0.6">Equator</text>
  
  <!-- Prime Meridian -->
  <line x1="400" y1="0" x2="400" y2="450" stroke="#ecc94b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8,4" opacity="0.6"/>
  <text x="405" y="15" fill="#ecc94b" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="10" opacity="0.6">Prime Meridian</text>
  
  <!-- Continents Group -->
  <g filter="url(#dropShadow)">
    
    <!-- North America -->
    <path d="M 40,50 
             Q 80,40 120,50 
             Q 150,60 160,90 
             Q 170,120 155,150 
             Q 140,180 110,190 
             Q 80,200 60,180 
             Q 30,160 25,130 
             Q 20,100 30,70 
             Q 35,55 40,50 Z" 
          fill="url(#naGrad)" stroke="#2f855a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Greenland -->
    <path d="M 130,20 
             Q 160,15 180,25 
             Q 190,50 170,70 
             Q 150,80 120,70 
             Q 100,60 110,35 
             Q 115,25 130,20 Z" 
          fill="url(#naGrad)" stroke="#2f855a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.9"/>
    
    <!-- South America -->
    <path d="M 100,190 
             Q 130,180 150,190 
             Q 170,210 165,240 
             Q 160,280 140,310 
             Q 120,340 90,350 
             Q 60,355 45,330 
             Q 35,300 40,260 
             Q 45,220 70,200 
             Q 85,185 100,190 Z" 
          fill="url(#saGrad)" stroke="#c05621" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Europe -->
    <path d="M 360,50 
             Q 390,45 420,50 
             Q 440,55 450,70 
             Q 455,85 445,100 
             Q 435,115 410,115 
             Q 390,115 375,100 
             Q 360,85 355,65 
             Q 355,55 360,50 Z" 
          fill="url(#euGrad)" stroke="#2c5282" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Africa -->
    <path d="M 380,100 
             Q 420,90 460,100 
             Q 490,120 500,150 
             Q 510,190 495,230 
             Q 480,270 440,290 
             Q 400,310 350,300 
             Q 310,290 290,250 
             Q 275,210 290,170 
             Q 305,130 340,110 
             Q 360,100 380,100 Z" 
          fill="url(#afGrad)" stroke="#b7791f" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Asia (large) -->
    <path d="M 460,50 
             Q 520,40 580,50 
             Q 630,55 650,80 
             Q 670,100 660,130 
             Q 650,160 620,180 
             Q 590,200 550,200 
             Q 510,200 490,180 
             Q 470,160 460,130 
             Q 455,100 460,70 
             Q 460,55 460,50 Z" 
          fill="url(#asGrad)" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Russia extension -->
    <path d="M 460,50 
             Q 500,30 550,40 
             Q 580,20 620,35 
             Q 640,50 630,70 
             Q 620,85 580,80 
             Q 540,75 500,70 
             Q 480,60 460,50 Z" 
          fill="url(#asGrad)" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- India subcontinent -->
    <path d="M 500,180 
             Q 520,185 530,200 
             Q 535,220 520,235 
             Q 505,245 485,235 
             Q 470,225 475,205 
             Q 480,185 500,180 Z" 
          fill="url(#asGrad)" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Southeast Asia islands -->
    <g fill="url(#asGrad)" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="0.8">
      <ellipse cx="560" cy="210" rx="15" ry="8"/>
      <ellipse cx="580" cy="205" rx="12" ry="7"/>
      <ellipse cx="570" cy="225" rx="10" ry="6"/>
      <ellipse cx="590" cy="220" rx="14" ry="8"/>
      <ellipse cx="605" cy="210" rx="10" ry="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Japan -->
    <path d="M 650,80 
             Q 660,75 665,85 
             Q 670,100 660,115 
             Q 650,125 640,115 
             Q 635,100 640,85 
             Q 645,78 650,80 Z" 
          fill="url(#asGrad)" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Australia -->
    <path d="M 580,290 
             Q 610,280 640,290 
             Q 660,300 655,320 
             Q 650,340 620,345 
             Q 590,350 565,335 
             Q 550,320 555,300 
             Q 560,285 580,290 Z" 
          fill="url(#auGrad)" stroke="#553c9a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- Tasmania -->
    <ellipse cx="600" cy="355" rx="8" ry="5" fill="url(#auGrad)" stroke="#553c9a" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- New Zealand -->
    <ellipse cx="670" cy="345" rx="10" ry="5" fill="url(#auGrad)" stroke="#553c9a" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="675" cy="360" rx="8" ry="4" fill="url(#auGrad)" stroke="#553c9a" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Antarctica -->
    <path d="M 100,420 
             Q 200,410 300,415 
             Q 400,420 500,415 
             Q 600,410 700,420 
             Q 720,430 700,445 
             Q 600,450 400,450 
             Q 200,450 80,440 
             Q 60,430 100,420 Z" 
          fill="url(#anGrad)" stroke="#a0aec0" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
    
    <!-- Antarctica detail -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="435" rx="120" ry="15" fill="#e2e8f0" opacity="0.4"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Country Labels -->
  <g font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif" filter="url(#textGlow)">
    
    <!-- United States -->
    <text x="85" y="110" fill="#ffffff" font-size="14" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.5px">UNITED STATES</text>
    <text x="85" y="126" fill="#c6f6d5" font-size="10" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle">USA</text>
    
    <!-- Canada -->
    <text x="100" y="60" fill="#ffffff" font-size="11" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">CANADA</text>
    
    <!-- Brazil -->
    <text x="110" y="270" fill="#ffffff" font-size="13" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.5px">BRAZIL</text>
    
    <!-- Russia -->
    <text x="530" y="65" fill="#ffffff" font-size="14" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="1px">RUSSIA</text>
    
    <!-- China -->
    <text x="570" y="140" fill="#ffffff" font-size="14" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="1px">CHINA</text>
    
    <!-- India -->
    <text x="500" y="225" fill="#ffffff" font-size="11" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle">INDIA</text>
    
    <!-- Australia -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 600" width="100%" height="100%" style="background-color: #0b0f19; border-radius: 16px;" role="img" aria-label="Simplified world map showing major continents and country labels">
  <defs>
    <!-- Drop Shadow Filter for Continents -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="5" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.5"/>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Embedded Stylesheet -->
    <style>
      .bg { fill: #0b0f19; }
      .grid-line { stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
      .equator { stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 8,4; }
      .map-border { stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 2; fill: none; }
      
      /* Continents styling with hover transitions */
      .continent {
        filter: url(#shadow);
        transition: fill 0.3s ease, filter 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .continent:hover {
        filter: drop-shadow(0px 0px 12px var(--glow-color)) brightness(1.1);
      }
      
      /* Colors and Glow Variables per Continent */
      #north-america { fill: #38bdf8; --glow-color: #38bdf8; }
      #south-america { fill: #fb7185; --glow-color: #fb7185; }
      #europe        { fill: #c084fc; --glow-color: #c084fc; }
      #africa        { fill: #fb923c; --glow-color: #fb923c; }
      #asia          { fill: #facc15; --glow-color: #facc15; }
      #australia     { fill: #2dd4bf; --glow-color: #2dd4bf; }
      #antarctica    { fill: #64748b; --glow-color: #64748b; opacity: 0.6; }
      
      #antarctica:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

      /* Subtle Continent Labels */
      .continent-label {
        font-family: 'Montserrat', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 3px;
        text-anchor: middle;
        pointer-events: none;
        user-select: none;
      }
      .lbl-na { fill: #0284c7; opacity: 0.75; }
      .lbl-sa { fill: #e11d48; opacity: 0.75; }
      .lbl-eu { fill: #9333ea; opacity: 0.85; }
      .lbl-af { fill: #ea580c; opacity: 0.75; }
      .lbl-as { fill: #ca8a04; opacity: 0.75; }
      .lbl-au { fill: #0d9488; opacity: 0.85; }
      .lbl-an { fill: #94a3b8; opacity: 0.75; }

      /* Country Pins & Labels */
      .pin circle {
        transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        transform-origin: center;
        transform-box: fill-box;
      }
      .pin:hover circle {
        transform: scale(1.3);
      }
      .pin-pulse {
        animation: pulse 2s infinite;
        transform-origin: center;
        transform-box: fill-box;
      }
      @keyframes pulse {
        0% { r: 3px; opacity: 1; }
        100% { r: 12px; opacity: 0; }
      }
      
      /* High-contrast text styling with paint-order halos */
      .country-label {
        font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        fill: #f8fafc;
        paint-order: stroke fill;
        stroke: #0b0f19;
        stroke-width: 3px;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
        pointer-events: none;
        user-select: none;
      }
      .minor-label {
        font-size: 9px;
        fill: #475569;

      <path d="M 445,285 L 490,270 L 535,275 L 565,290 L 575,325 L 610,345 L 635,370 L 610,410 L 585,465 L 560,515 L 545,515 L 525,480 L 515,440 L 500,410 L 475,385 L 435,375 L 420,345 L 425,310 Z" />
      <!-- Madagascar -->
      <path d="M 595,455 L 610,445 L 615,465 L 600,495 L 590,485 Z" />

      <path d="M 545,175 L 600,165 L 720,150 L 780,155 L 850,163 L 880,175 L 870,215 L 845,235 L 835,275 L 815,315 L 795,355 L 785,365 L 755,345 L 760,325 L 745,315 L 725,310 L 710,345 L 690,345 L 680,315 L 650,315 L 635,335 L 585,340 L 575,315 L 565,290 L 540,250 L 525,235 L 545,200 Z" />

      <!-- Tasmania -->

      <!-- New Zealand -->
      <path d="M 895,530 L 905,520 L 910,540 Z M 885,545 L 895,535 L 890,560 Z" />

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 550" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="oceanGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0b1329" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#162346" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Continent Glow Filter -->
    <filter id="glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.4" />
    </filter>

    <!-- Marker Pulse Animation Effect -->
    <filter id="markerGlow">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#ffffff" flood-opacity="0.6" />
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <style>
    /* Base Styles */
    .ocean { fill: url(#oceanGradient); }
    .grid-line { stroke: #ffffff; stroke-opacity: 0.06; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
    .equator { stroke: #ffffff; stroke-opacity: 0.15; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6,4; }
    
    /* Continent Styles */
    .continent {
      filter: url(#glow);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
      stroke-width: 0.5;
      stroke-opacity: 0.4;
      stroke: #ffffff;
    }
    .continent:hover {
      opacity: 0.85;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    
    .north-america { fill: #38bdf8; }
    .south-america { fill: #34d399; }
    .europe        { fill: #fbbf24; }
    .africa        { fill: #fb923c; }
    .asia          { fill: #f472b6; }
    .australia     { fill: #a78bfa; }
    .antarctica    { fill: #94a3b8; }

    /* Country Label Pins & Badges */
    .pin-pulse {
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { r: 3px; opacity: 1; }
      50% { r: 7px; opacity: 0.4; }
      100% { r: 3px; opacity: 1; }
    }

    .label-box {
      fill: #0f172a;
      fill-opacity: 0.85;
      stroke: #334155;
      stroke-width: 1;
      rx: 4px;
    }
    
    .labelText {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      fill: #f8fafc;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .label-connector {
      stroke: #94a3b8;
      stroke-width: 1;
      stroke-dasharray: 2,2;
    }

    /* Map Title & Legend */
    .title {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      fill: #f8fafc;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .subtitle {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      fill: #94a3b8;
      font-size: 11px;
    }
    .legend-text {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      font-size: 10px;
      fill: #cbd5e1;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Ocean Background -->
  <rect class="ocean" width="1000" height="550" rx="12" />

  <!-- Geographic Grid Lines -->
  <g>

    <!-- Latitude Lines -->

    <line x1="0" y1="420" x2="1000" y2="420" class="grid-line" />
  </g>

  <!-- CONTINENTS -->
  <g id="continents">
    
    <!-- NORTH AMERICA -->

      <!-- Greenland -->
      <path class="continent north-america" d="M 320 50 C 340 35, 380 35, 395 50 C 405 65, 385 95, 360 100 C 340 105, 315 80, 320 50 Z" />
      <!-- Mainland North America -->
      <path class="continent north-america" d="M 80 85 C 100 70, 140 65, 180 75 C 220 55, 270 65, 285 95 C 295 115, 315 125, 290 155 C 280 170, 290 200, 275 220 C 265 235, 235 230, 215 260 C 205 275, 185 245, 175 225 C 160 215, 120 220, 110 180 C 100 160, 125 140, 110 120 C 95 110, 70 100, 80 85 Z" />
      <!-- Caribbean Islands -->

      <circle class="continent north-america" cx="290" cy="242" r="3" />
    </g>

    <!-- SOUTH AMERICA -->

      <path class="continent south-america" d="M 245 285 C 275 275, 325 295, 355 320 C 385 345, 365 385, 335 415 C 315 440, 300 480, 285 485 C 275 490, 265 460, 270 420 C 275 380, 245 350, 240 325 C 235 300, 230 290, 245 285 Z" />
    </g>

    <!-- EUROPE -->
    <g id="europe">
      <!-- Mainland Europe -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 400" width="100%" height="100%">

             L 430 75 L 450 115 L 420 160 L 380 165 L 360 135 L 355 90 Z"

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 680" width="1200" height="680"

  city markers, ocean names, trade routes and a compass rose.</desc>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="oceanG" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="680">
      <stop offset="0"   stop-color="#0a2440"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#0e3a5f"/>
      <stop offset="1"   stop-color="#14547f"/>

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#78beff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="vignette" cx=".5" cy=".5" r=".75">
      <stop offset=".7" stop-color="#030a14" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1"  stop-color="#030a14" stop-opacity=".3"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="iceG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2f7fb"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c3d8e9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">

  <style>
    .display { font-family:'Palatino Linotype','Book Antiqua',Palatino,Georgia,serif; }

               fill:#fff; stroke:#0a1e33; paint-order:stroke; letter-spacing:2px; }
    .oceanLbl{ font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif; font-style:italic;
               fill:#bfe3ff; letter-spacing:3px; opacity:.75; }
    .land    { transition: transform .35s ease, filter .35s ease; cursor:pointer; }
    .land:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); filter: brightness(1.16) saturate(1.12); }
    .route   { fill:none; stroke:#ffdf9e; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-dasharray:7 7;
               opacity:.55; animation:dashmove 3.2s linear infinite; }
    .cloudA  { animation:drift 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .cloudB  { animation:drift 34s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
    .cloudC  { animation:drift 30s ease-in-out 4s infinite alternate; }
    .needle  { transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center;
               animation:sway 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes dashmove { to { stroke-dashoffset:-56; } }
    @keyframes drift { from { transform:translateX(-28px);} to { transform:translateX(28px);} }
    @keyframes sway  { from { transform:rotate(-9deg);}     to { transform:rotate(9deg);} }

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 700" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <!-- Ocean Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="oceanGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e8f4f8"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#d6ebf2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c4e2ec"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Land Drop Shadows -->
    <filter id="dropShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="125%" height="125%">
      <feDropShadow dx="1" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#1e3a56" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="badgeShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2.5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.15"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Continent Gradients -->
    <!-- North America (Warm Coral) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradNA" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f28e79"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e76f51"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- South America (Emerald/Mint) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradSA" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#52b788"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a9d8f"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Europe (Cobalt/Denim) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradEU" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6495ed"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4663ac"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Africa (Golden Sand) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradAF" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f4bb61"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e99d42"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Asia (Royal Orchid/Plum) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradAS" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#af7ac5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#884ea0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Oceania (Seafoam Teal) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradOC" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#48cae4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0096c7"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Antarctica (Glacier Blue) -->
    <linearGradient id="gradAN" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c5dbe8"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <style>
    text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }
    .graticule { stroke: #bedde6; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; fill: none; }
    .special-lat { stroke: #9ecad8; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 6,4; fill: none; }
    .equator { stroke: #7bb5c7; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: none; }
    .land { filter: url(#dropShadow); stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .badge { filter: url(#badgeShadow); }
    .badge-bg { fill: #ffffff; rx: 12; }
